title: Anchorage logo marquee
description: A small centred heading over an endless row of big wordmarks gliding slowly to the left, edge to edge. Names are typeset in four looks (plain, spaced caps, heavy italic, stacked) so the row keeps a mixed-logo rhythm; real logo images can replace them.
notes: CSS-only loop (the list is drawn twice); speed in seconds per lap
reduced motion stops the row; it then scrolls sideways by hand
